summary: SMFG filed a 6-K attaching a news release confirming a statutory share exchange to place its wholly-owned SMBC Nikko Securities Inc. under a new intermediate holding company, SMBC Nikko Securities Holdings Inc., effective October 1, 2026. The preparatory company issues just one share to SMFG in exchange for 200,002 SMBC Nikko shares, keeping group ownership wholly intact. Shareholder approvals are expected September 30, 2026, with the agreement signed the same day. This is an internal reorganization supporting a Japanese equities joint venture with Jefferies, not an arm's-length special situation; watch for regulatory and JV integration risk.
